scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && poetry run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000 --loop app.core.loop:selector_loop_factory
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && poetry run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:revision: cd apps/api && poetry run alembic revision --autogenerate -m
scripts.lint:api: cd apps/api && poetry run ruff check app tests alembic && poetry run ruff format --check app tests alembic && poetry run mypy app tests alembic
scripts.lint:web: yarn workspace web lint && yarn workspace web typecheck
